## What's free

Lite plan: 10 GB storage, 10 Pulse compute-hours/month, 3 users and 2 service accounts; serverless DuckDB for analytics

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://motherduck.com/pricing/> before relying on this.

## Notes

Queries stop when a free limit is exceeded: over the storage cap blocks queries on MotherDuck storage, over the compute cap blocks queries until the month resets.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
